title: world/world.json, jrpgbattle world format 2026-11-17
description: A world's own description (decision 0086): the ruleset it plays, the date of that ruleset's world format its files are written in, and the ruleset's optional features it enables, each with its values. A world naming another ruleset or format is refused by name, and a server doesn't start on it.

ruleset.description: The id of the ruleset the world plays: the server imports src/rulesets/<id>/index.js.

formatVersion.description: The ruleset's world format (its ruleset.json formatVersion): every file of the world is in it.

levels.description: Levels and XP: the cap and the curve, laid into the config's rules (rules.maxLevel and the rest).

maxLevel.description: The highest level a hero reaches.

xpLevelStep.description: How much more each level after costs.

xpKillerShare.description: The share of a kill's XP the killer takes for a direct hit; the rest is shared.
